findings.implementedOrEstablished: Systematically reconciled all 335 base records with eleven complete numbered PowerPyx world guides and targeted GamerGuides checks. All 245 chests and 90 emblems have pickup landmarks, stable IDs and per-record guide provenance. Added post-clear recovery, explicit camera/night/story gates and Sandbar lagoon approach.

Original console guides align with current base identities but are not modern Steam capture authority; aliases remain KH3-002. No direction remains unresearched or area-only because a wiki cell was blank.
